main_measure.name: mean excess 30-bar return (minus coin's normal 30-bar drift) on grid bars with forecast > 0

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and slope on forecast > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; fewer than 30 cases on distinct days: not enough

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 30-bar return on forecast across cases

decided_by: Fewer than 30 cases on distinct days (29), the plan's minimum count.
reading: Grid bars at positions 0, 30, 60, ... of each window with a full 30-bar forward return inside the window; normal drift is each coin's mean 30-bar return over all its windows' grid bars; t uses day-clustered deviations (summed per UTC day) with a D/(D-1) correction; the plan's 'fewer than 30 cases on distinct days' is applied as the minimum count giving 'not observable'.
